fields.h1: Build a Spray Tanning Consent Form Signed Before Every Tan
fields.hero_description: Build a spray tanning consent form clients sign on their phone, with skin and allergy answers saved to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the Tanner Reads Before the First Pass
fields.features_subheading: Six parts hold what an artist checks before spraying, and each client's signed copies stay together for the next appointment.
fields.feature_1:
Skin and allergy questions with details

Ask about known allergies, skin conditions, and anything the client wants the artist to know. A yes opens a text box, and the artist reads that detail before she picks up the gun.
fields.feature_2:
Your prep instructions, one checkbox each

List each instruction you give before a tan, such as arriving with clean skin, on its own line. The client ticks every line, and the record shows which ones she confirmed.
fields.feature_3:
A parent signature for clients under 18

Ask for a date of birth first. A client under 18 gets a section for a parent's name and e-signature, and her booking shows as waiting until that parent has signed the form.
fields.feature_4:
Signed on a phone or the front desk tablet

Clients sign from the link in their booking email or on a tablet at check-in. The app captures the e-signature and files it with that visit's answers and the solution used.
fields.feature_5:
No response caps during prom season

Fill every booth slot through prom and wedding weeks, and the form keeps taking signatures with no response caps. Each signed copy becomes a row in a database you own.
fields.feature_6:
Export the code to your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code of the consent app to your GitHub repository. A developer can then put the form inside your booking site and keep building it there.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Signs, and When, at Four Tan Businesses
fields.tab_content_1:
Oonagh reads all of Cassia's answers in the car

Oonagh Bettencourt tans clients in their own homes under the name Halcyon Bronze. Cassia Velloso signs the consent form from her booking email the night before. Parked outside the next morning, Oonagh opens the signed form on her phone and reads every answer before the 7:30 am appointment.
fields.tab_content_2:
Each junior waits on a parent's signature

Prom week at Amberlight Tan Studio brings 5 juniors booked for Saturday. Each fills in her own form, and any client under 18 needs a parent's e-signature before she is sprayed. On Thursday, owner Ilsabet Corriveau sees 3 of 5 cleared and 2 still waiting on a parent.
fields.tab_content_3:
Leilani signs once, and that one form covers both coats

Competitors at Sunmark Tan Co. book 2 coats before a show. Leilani Strand's are Friday at 8 pm and Saturday at 6 am. She signs one consent form that lists both sessions, and artist Fenna Gilchrist marks coat 1 done on Friday night. Saturday's coat 2 starts from the same form.
fields.tab_content_4:
Ottilie's record keeps every one of her 7 signatures

Ottilie Faraday has been tanning at Pelican Row Tan Bar since last spring. On her 7th visit, the front desk tablet shows her last answers. She confirms that none have changed and signs. The new copy joins the 6 she signed before, each kept with its date.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Spray Tanning Consent Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a spray tanning consent form that holds each client's answers, prep checks, and signatures.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Copy every question off the paper
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Split the prep instructions into lines
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Have a lawyer read the wording
fields.howto_step_1_des: If your spray tanning consent form lives on a clipboard today, write out every question on it. Add the ones your artists ask out loud in the booth, such as which shade the client wants, and drop any question nobody reads.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List the notes an artist makes after each session: the solution and shade, the number of coats, and who sprayed. Each note becomes a field. Mark which fields the client fills in and which ones the artist completes after the tan.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Break the prep and aftercare instructions you hand out into short statements, one per line, each with a checkbox. Short lines read better on a phone than a paragraph does, and the record shows every box the client ticked.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Your lawyer or insurance agent should read the consent wording, including any line about reactions to the solution, before it goes live. Put their edits into the form word for word, and save each approved version with the date it took effect.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the form in one prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write one prompt that walks through the form in the order a client meets it: contact details, health questions, prep checklist, consent, signature. Emergent builds the form and the database that holds each signed copy. Prompt again when a question needs new wording.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Send the link with the booking email
fields.howto_step_6_des: Choose when clients get the form. A link in the booking confirmation lets them answer at home, and a reminder the day before reaches anyone who has not signed. If your booking tool has an API, connect it to the app.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book two made-up clients through the form: an adult regular and a 16-year-old whose parent has to sign. Check that each signature lands on the right record with the answers above it, then publish the form and share its link.

plan.angle: The search results for this keyword are printable templates and e-sign template sites that hand a tanning studio one static sheet. This page shows what a spray tanning consent form records for spray tans in particular (skin and allergy questions, the prep checklist, a parent signature for clients under 18, the solution used) and four businesses that use it at different moments: a mobile tanner reading a client's answers before she knocks, a studio clearing a prom group whose parents sign, a competition tan split across two coats on one signed form, and a front desk tablet where a returning client confirms her answers.
